title: Arkret Contact and Direct Conversation Operation DTOs
description: Closed request/response DTO bundle for the Contact lifecycle: request, respond, reject, scope replacement, tombstone, the portable Contact round evidence bundle, acceptance receipts and the peer Contact carrier, plus the contact-list projection.

bilateral_continuity_checkpoint_core.description: Domain-neutral, root-anchored commitment to one contiguous prefix of a bilateral lineage. Sequence is monotonic; same sequence with a different checkpoint digest is a fork, never a winner election.

participant_ids.description: The two exact ActorIds, sorted by RFC 8785 canonical bytes.

root_basis.description: Portable uncheckpointed root Contact round evidence. It is retained so founder and root identity remain independently derivable after prefix compaction.

covered_through_contact_round_id.description: The exact terminal contact_round_id at the compacted-prefix boundary. The oldest remaining tail edge points here; bundle content digests are accumulated only in prefix_accumulator_root.

signatures.description: Exactly one signature by each registered participant authority key over the checkpoint core.

bilateral_continuity_checkpoint_proposal.description: One participant service's immutable proposal. It is never portable continuity evidence until the other service returns and durably commits the completed two-signature checkpoint.

uncompressed_tail_entries.description: Immediate predecessor first; at least the latest terminal round remains explicit, and the final edge must terminate exactly at checkpoint.core.covered_through_contact_round_id.

contact_continuity_checkpoint_request_bo.description: Holder-authorized command to compact the deterministic oldest terminal prefix. The caller never supplies the checkpoint core or boundary.

recipient.description: Exact Contact participant receiving this private delivery. The delivery Station is derived from the human account_id.station_id or the agent controller_account_id.station_id and is not carried as a parallel identity field.

service_resolution.description: First-hop transport material for the Station derived from recipient.

route_assistance.description: Optional transport-only hints for recovering the same recipient_id route during Contact delivery bootstrap. They are not part of the signed Contact Event, Contact projection, Realm member typed current result or authority state; they do not extend any token/receipt TTL or authorize delivery.

sorted_pair_member_ids.description: Exactly two distinct full ActorIds, strictly ascending by their RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 unsigned bytes. Validation rejects noncanonical order without sorting the received array.
Exactly two distinct full ActorIds, strictly ascending by their RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 unsigned bytes. Validation rejects noncanonical order without sorting the received array.

requests.description: Exactly two distinct request_event_ref values, strictly ascending by the complete typed EventId wire string UTF-8 unsigned bytes. Receipt digest is not a sort key or tiebreaker. Duplicate refs are invalid even with different digests. Receivers reject unsorted input without normalization. The signed request Event author ActorId of requests[0], not the Station receipt issuer_id, is the root-round founder.

previous_terminal_contact_round_id.description: Absent only for a root Contact round. On recontact it is copied from every signed request fact and request acceptance receipt in this bundle and points to the immediately preceding terminal round. The bundle field is derived convenience, never independent authority.

continuity_checkpoint.description: Latest mutually signed compacted prefix for this lineage. Its presence changes the chain terminator from the root round to covered_through_contact_round_id; it never changes the root basis or participant authority pair.

contact_current_proof.description: Existing source Station attestation of its confirmed directional Contact projection. Authorizing proofs are issued only after the exact source command is committed by the unique confirmed RealmCommit; the peer verifies the independently derived Station's historical service authority and the original holder producer separately, without receiving private PCR history.

issuer_id.description: Station service authority independently derived from the exact directional participant and verified at signature.created_at. It is not a Contact participant identity; fresh_until is a freshness limit, not an authority-history lookup time.

peer.description: Signed peer component of the issuer-local lineage key. The directional subject is the other exact member of the bound Contact pair.

head_event_ref.description: Complete identity of the actual confirmed current-head Event at proof issuance. It may equal the carrier's original fact or be its authenticated same-direction successor; exact coverage requires the complete verified predecessor chain, never only a larger complete_through. A round-wide terminal uses the separately verified source tombstone and counterpart fence rules. Missing chain material stays non-authorizing pending. A source MUST NOT sign a superseded fact as a fresh head or backdate a proof. Its digest is derived by decoding this suite-tagged full-digest EventId; no parallel head_digest is carried.

terminal.description: Signed current-head classification. true authenticates the round-wide fence from a confirmed ak.contact.tombstone; both directional proofs may reference that same source tombstone without inventing another holder Event. The counterpart verifies the original source proof and retains its own direction's complete_through version. Incomplete local direction material permits a known-terminal fence but no fabricated completeness proof. A historical predecessor in a recontact continuity chain requires true from both directional proofs.

complete_through.description: Last completely authenticated version of the direction identified by (contact_round_id, issuer_id, peer): initial normal accepted or implicit glare request head is 1, successors use their confirmed payload.version. Never PCR producer_revision, request slot_version, RealmCommit height or receiver time. A counterpart terminal acknowledgement retains its local confirmed version, without copying the remote version or incrementing it.

fresh_until.description: Current freshness bound for Contact mutation and Direct Conversation security founding. Expiry alone does not revoke a previously fully verified ordinary-message authorization interval or require the source Station online; known revocations and actual authorization bounds still apply.

request_message.description: The exact verified request Event message, present only for pending_incoming and only when that Event carries message.

effective_scopes.description: Optional shorthand. When present, MUST equal bidirectional_scopes.

continuity_evidence.description: Explicit export only: present when include_continuity=true and a committed portable checkpoint exists. Ordinary list responses omit it. Online recontact uses Station durable evidence.

contact_next_prepare_input.description: Closed successor cursor for the holder's own issuer-local Contact lineage, carried only by the ak.self.contact.read.list.v1 projection. The container name carries the tense: version is the version the NEXT Event carries, that is current head version plus one, hence the minimum of 2; predecessor_event_ref is the current lineage head Event ID, that is the predecessor the next Event must name, and never the predecessor of the current head. The three field names are byte-identical to the prepare-phase fields of ak.self.contact.command.scope_update.v1 and ak.self.contact.command.tombstone.v1 and MUST be copied verbatim; a client MUST NOT rename, recompute or derive them, and MUST NOT assemble a successor from request_event_ref, response_event_ref or tombstone_event_ref, which are projection summaries and not authoritative lineage heads. Presence is fixed by contact_state: an accepted row MUST carry it, and a pending_outgoing, pending_incoming, rejected, expired or tombstoned row MUST NOT, because the first two have no basis or lineage yet and the last three are terminal. Absence is the sole encoding of 'no successor is authorable now'; no extra error code or contact_state value expresses it. A stale cursor is refused by prepare with contact_lineage_conflict or contact_scope_stale; the client MUST re-read this operation and retry with the fresh values, and MUST NOT guess a head or retry the same triple.

continuity_evidence.description: Explicit portable import. The Station validates the checkpoint and bounded tail, binds the exact pair and committed lineage, and derives the predecessor. Ordinary online recontact loads Station durable evidence instead.

block_peer.description: Holder-private commit side effect. true adds the peer to invite receive policy denied_subjects; false only tombstones the Contact lineage. This field is reservation-bound and is not copied into the public Contact Event payload.

direct_conversation_summary.description: Contact-list projection of an already materialized stable Direct Conversation. Coordinates and binding identity are immutable; state only says whether the same conversation is currently sendable. Creation progress is exposed only by direct_conversation_resolve_outcome; there is no durable creation operation, draft or reservation.

subject_id.description: Exact Contact participant whose Station issued this directional attestation.

issuer_id.description: Station service authority that signed this attestation at observed_at.

glare_concurrency_attestation.description: Source-service-signed evidence for the subject_id -> peer_id direction that both request receipts were accepted while neither request slot had yet been consumed. A glare bundle requires the two opposite directions; issuer_id is the signing service and is never used as the participant discriminator.

normal_response_acceptance_receipt.description: Source Station attestation issued only after the exact response Event's command unit is committed and its Contact effect atomically installed. Pending admission or proposal acknowledgement is not this receipt.

response_event_ref.description: Complete identity of the accepted response Event. Its digest is derived by decoding this suite-tagged full-digest EventId; no parallel response_digest is carried.

outgoing_slot_absence_digest.description: H('ak.contact.no_outgoing_slot.v1', outgoing_slot_absence_transcript) over the exact closed transcript defined by identity/contact-and-direct-conversation.md section 2.

peer_contact_authoritative_mirror_receip.description: Only an accepted or duplicate mirror receipt proves that the immutable signed Contact fact is durably mirrored. A deferred receipt is never authority for proof refresh or glare finalization.

result_digest.description: H('ak.peer-contact.control-result.v1',{request_digest,result_kind,glare_concurrency_attestation?,current_proof?}) over the exact closed successful result.

peer_contact_control_receipt.description: The recipient signs every field except signature. This receipt is only for proof_refresh, glare_finalize or continuity_checkpoint and cannot stand in for a signed Event mirror receipt.

peer_contact_event_submit_outcome.description: Only the five signed Contact Event request kinds use this branch. The receipt event coordinates and result_kind must match the submitted Event exactly. Request/response may return a current proof; accepted or duplicate scope/tombstone must return one; reject and deferred never do.

signed_event_ref.description: Complete identity of the mirrored signed Event. Its digest is derived by decoding this suite-tagged full-digest EventId; request_digest remains the distinct digest of the peer submit request.

peer_contact_submit_request.description: Closed Contact-only peer carrier. Each Event branch carries existing source Station attestation of a truly RealmCommit-committed Contact projection; pending admission cannot produce an authorizing receipt or receipted outbox. The original holder producer remains independently authenticated. No private PCR bootstrap, RealmCommit or new confirmation field is carried.

reject_acceptance_receipt.description: Source Station attestation of the committed Contact rejection Event, which is a successful terminal domain command. A RealmCommit-rejected command or pending Event cannot produce this receipt.

reject_event_ref.description: Complete identity of the accepted reject Event. Its digest is derived by decoding this suite-tagged full-digest EventId; no parallel reject_digest is carried.

request_acceptance_receipt.description: Source Station attestation issued only after the exact request Event's command unit is committed and its Contact effect atomically installed. It may seed normal/glare round evidence; a pending admission receipt cannot occupy this type.

previous_terminal_contact_round_id.description: Present exactly when this accepted request starts a recontact after a prior accepted Contact round became terminal. It MUST equal the requester-signed ak.contact.requested payload field and is covered by receipt_digest/signature. It is distinct from slot_predecessor, which is the issuer-local request-slot CAS predecessor and can also follow a rejected proposal.

request_event_ref.description: Complete identity of the accepted request Event. Its digest is derived by decoding this suite-tagged full-digest EventId; no parallel request_digest is carried.

contact_producer_signer.description: Exact-Event source-signed producer projection. Closed direct and delegated branches are distinguished by delegated_actor_did presence, with no new wire tag. Enclosing carrier validation MUST select delegated if and only if the original Event is a legal Agent controller-device Event with executed_by; human and Agent runtime use direct. Method/raw32 authenticate the original producer, while delegated_actor_did only locates the independently verified Agent public identity. No reusable authorization, new endpoint or private PCR disclosure is created.

public_key_b64u.description: Canonical unpadded base64url of the exact Ed25519 raw32 key independently verified by the source for this confirmed Contact Event.

contact_direct_producer_signer.description: Closed direct producer branch for human-device and Agent-runtime Contact Events. The original Event has no executed_by; its producer method already locates its Actor DID. No delegated_actor_did is permitted.

public_key_b64u.description: Canonical unpadded base64url of the exact Ed25519 raw32 key independently verified by the source for this confirmed Contact Event.

delegated_actor_did.description: Complete public DID locator of the exact Agent Event actor, frozen from the source-verified native identity binding when the original Event has executed_by. It is not the executor DID, a core-derived locator, or authorization.

contact_delegated_producer_signer.description: Closed delegated producer branch, required exactly for a legal Agent controller-device Contact Event with executed_by. The receiver verifies the original producer signature and separately validates this complete Agent DID history against exact actor/controller/Station and the create-locked tuple.
